{"operations": [
  {"op": "moveClass", "class": "org.apache.commons.exec.launcher.CommandLauncher", "to": "org.apache.commons.exec.environment"},
  {"op": "moveClass", "class": "org.apache.commons.exec.launcher.CommandLauncherFactory", "to": "org.apache.commons.exec.environment"},
  {"op": "moveClass", "class": "org.apache.commons.exec.launcher.CommandLauncherImpl", "to": "org.apache.commons.exec.environment"},
  {"op": "moveClass", "class": "org.apache.commons.exec.launcher.CommandLauncherProxy", "to": "org.apache.commons.exec.environment"},
  {"op": "moveClass", "class": "org.apache.commons.exec.launcher.Java13CommandLauncher", "to": "org.apache.commons.exec.environment"},
  {"op": "moveClass", "class": "org.apache.commons.exec.launcher.OS2CommandLauncher", "to": "org.apache.commons.exec.environment"},
  {"op": "moveClass", "class": "org.apache.commons.exec.launcher.VmsCommandLauncher", "to": "org.apache.commons.exec.environment"},
  {"op": "moveClass", "class": "org.apache.commons.exec.launcher.WinNTCommandLauncher", "to": "org.apache.commons.exec.environment"},
  {"op": "invertEdge", "consumer": "org.apache.commons.exec.environment", "impl": "org.apache.commons.exec.launcher.CommandLauncher"}
],
"rationale": "This plan breaks the cycle by moving all launcher-related classes into the environment package and inverting the edge between them, ensuring that the environment package depends on the launcher package's interfaces rather than its implementations."}
